---
title: FAIR with FHIR
subtitle: A proposed workflow for retrospective FAIRification of FHIR-compliant health data
description: |
  FAIRwithFHIR is an agile, stakeholder-driven workflow for the retrospective FAIRification of FHIR-compliant resources, including the dynamic, transaction-oriented data typical of operational health systems. We demonstrate and evaluate this workflow by applying it to the MomCare dataset, a large maternal and child health dataset from Kenya.
